description: This file contains API service functions for managing WLAN configurations, including fetching and updating basic, advanced, WPS, and mesh WLAN settings, with mock data support for development environment.

methods.name: getWlanBasic
methods.description: Fetches basic WLAN configuration, returns mock data in development.

methods.name: updateWlanBasic
methods.description: Updates basic WLAN configuration, sends data to API or returns mock data.

methods.name: getWlanBasicMulti
methods.description: Fetches multi-SSID WLAN group configuration, transforms response if needed.

methods.name: updateWlanAdvanced
methods.description: Updates advanced WLAN settings, with data transformation in development.
